title:
Transform to define the percentage of training and validation for time ranges, compatible with both bulk
and single asset dataset preparation. Expects an object `params` as input with the following properties:
- `isBulk`
- `trainingPercentage`
- `validationPercentage`
- `trainingPercentageBulk`
- `validationPercentageBulk`
Returns `trainingPercentage` and `validationPercentage` based on the value of `isBulk`
name: DatasetPreparationSingleAndBulkPercentagesTransform
